description:
PeopleGrove builds software for 650+ colleges and universities. Our Hubs portfolio (Engagement Hub, Experience Hub, PathwayU) helps students and alumni connect, find mentors, and prepare for careers. We are a PE-owned company with a strong product team and an engineering team in India.

The role

We need someone who can set the strategy for Hubs and turn it into designs and specs the team can build. This is a hands-on, results-first role. You will not run a long discovery process. You will learn fast, make clear calls, and hand off work that is ready to build.

What you'll do

  • Review the current Hubs products, customer feedback, research, usage data, and the competitive market in your first week.
  • Deliver a strategy, vision, and plan by the end of week one. It should be clear enough to explain to our CEO and board.
  • In weeks two to four, turn the plan into detailed designs and specs. You will use Claude to build prototypes and write specs yourself.
  • Hand off to the product and engineering teams, answer their questions, and stay involved as the work gets built.
  • After the first month, take on a series of projects across the year. The VP of Product will provide the roadmap. For each project, you own the work from strategy through designs, specs, and handoff.
  • Work with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to make sure each project solves real customer problems.

    • What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years in product, including real ownership of strategy and the details behind it.
  • A track record of shipping. We will ask for examples where your strategy became a product customers use.
  • Comfort with specifics. You think through edge cases, user flows, and tradeoffs, and you can write them down clearly.
  • Experience using AI tools to design, prototype, and write specs. You can do this work yourself instead of waiting for a designer or analyst.
  • Strong judgment. You can sort through a lot of input and decide what matters.
  • Self-driven. You find answers on your own, do not wait for someone to assign tasks, and are fine with light process.
  • Experience working with distributed teams, ideally with engineering teams in India.
  • Clear, short, friendly communication, written and spoken.

    • Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS experience, especially in higher education, student success, mentorship, alumni engagement, or career services.
  • Experience with marketplace or community products.

    • Logistics

  • 12-month contract.
  • Remote.
  • Early morning meetings to overlap with the India team.
  • Some travel, such as customer visits or team on-sites.
  • Reports to the VP of Product.

    • At PeopleGrove, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. PeopleGrove is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

    If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careers@peoplegrove.com.
